Behind the image
21 / Midnight Mist
REFERENCE 5217.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 018
Art direction: Ethereal fantasy portrait, cold teal fog, pale silk, cinematic 35mm film color.
Cinematic vertical three-quarter portrait of an original adult woman with very long, dark, wet-look
wavy black hair falling down her back, pale skin, deep red-brown lips and a smoldering
over-the-shoulder glance. She wears a flowing pale blue-gray sleeveless fantasy gown with a
ruched corset bodice, soft tulle layers and delicate silver lace appliqué, and a thin silver bracelet.
Misty deep teal and midnight blue background with faint dark silhouettes of shrubs, cold diffused
light with a soft glow on the skin, romantic gothic fantasy mood, dreamy haze, analog film grain,
no text.
22 / Obsidian Close-Up
REFERENCE 5216.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 019
Art direction: Futuristic character portrait, glossy skin detail, cool gray-blue palette, quiet intensity.
Hyper-detailed photorealistic vertical close-up portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with
black hair loosely tied back, a few long strands falling across her face and cheek, a faint scatter of
freckles, glossy natural skin with visible pores, dark brown eyes with a serious, slightly weary gaze
and soft dusty-rose lips. She wears a black ribbed turtleneck beneath dark navy futuristic
armor-like shoulder panels. Smooth gray-blue studio background, soft cool key light with gentle
highlights on the forehead and nose, subtle catchlights in the eyes, cool desaturated blue-gray
palette, sharp 85mm portrait lens detail, cinematic sci-fi character study, no text or logos.
